changelog.summary: 0.8.0-rc.2 fixes the duplicate plan.create race when entering Plan Review and makes short-page sources explicit: quick scan requests a full bounded page while keeping only the requested window, and any remaining source-side short page is reported with requested/scanned/available counts instead of looking like local index loss. See docs/migration-studio/ACCEPTANCE-FIXES-0.8.0-ALPHA.md.

desktop.changelog: Desktop 0.8.0-rc.2: Plan Review uses one single-flight preview request with a request epoch, so entering step 5 produces exactly one plan.create and a successful preview clears any stale planning error. Quick scan requests a full 100-item page while indexing only the requested count, so sources with partial REST pages (NASA) still fill the window; genuine under-returns are reported as a source short page. Adds a renderer regression test and packaged-GUI controls I and J.

publisher.changelog: Unchanged in this release; the Publisher artifact is byte-identical to 0.8.0-alpha.2.

cms.changelog: CMS 0.8.0-alpha.8: optional featured images with existing-QDN selection, device upload, preview, replace, remove and deterministic first-suitable-body-image fallback; explicit WordPress featured images preserved; persistence in the native index, qms-qdn-content@1 media.featured and the edit overlay; reuse by content hash; rendering on home cards, lists, detail and search; fee quote includes a new image resource. Adds visible template version and stale-deployment guidance, refuses an untouched one-character automatic slug from a longer title while preserving legitimate short and manual slugs, and fixes media-map array normalization. Includes all CMS 0.8.0-alpha.7/6/5 fixes. See docs/migration-studio/CMS-EDITING-AND-SLUGS.md.
